richiami.difetto: Due to a defect in the engine control unit (inverter) in vehicles equipped with electrified dual-clutch transmission (e-DCT), metal soldering residues may pass into the unit. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

richiami.difetto: The DV5R engine may experience a loss of power due to slippage of the water pump pulley. This slippage can cause misalignment of the timing belt, potentially resulting in engine shutdown. The sprocket of the water pump pulley may detach from the shaft, which can lead to the loss of parts on the road and increase the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

traduzione.difetto: Il motore DV5R potrebbe sperimentare una perdita di potenza a causa dello scivolamento del polso del pompa di raffreddamento. Questo scivolamento può causare un'allineamento errato della cinghia di distribuzione, potenzialmente provocando lo spegnimento del motore. Il pignone del polso della pompa di raffreddamento potrebbe staccarsi dall'albero, il che può portare alla perdita di parti sulla strada e aumentare il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

In wet conditions, the insufficient clearance and contact between these components can lead to water infiltration, causing an electric arc which may trigger a thermal event, such as overheating. There is a risk of fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

richiami.difetto: The brake pedal support may not be attached securely enough due to a missing or poorly assembled pin. If the pin falls, the brake pedal could disengage, making it impossible to stop the vehicle. This may lead to injuries. If the brake pedal fails, the electronic parking brake on the centre console may be used while driving to slow the vehicle down to a controlled stop. Furthermore, when active, the automatic emergency braking system intervenes when it detects an imminent collision. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

richiami.difetto: The aluminium of the EBS valve block may not fully cast around the valves. This can lead to an internal leak of brake fluid (from one or more of the 12 valve seats) resulting in a reduction of the fluid level and the deactivation of stability control due to damage to the pressure sensor. The brake fluid could come into contact with the printed circuit board and result in the deactivation of all control functions (including the anti-lock system and electronic brake force distribution). The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 14/04/2025

traduzione.difetto: L'alluminio del blocco della valvola EBS potrebbe non essere stato completamente gettato intorno alle valvole. Ciò può provocare una perdita interna di fluido frenante (da una o più delle 12 sedi valvole), causando una riduzione del livello del fluido e la disattivazione del controllo della stabilità a causa del danno al sensore di pressione. Il fluido frenante potrebbe entrare in contatto con la scheda elettronica, provocando la disattivazione di tutte le funzioni di controllo (compresi il sistema antiscivolo e la distribuzione elettronica della forza frenante). Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: An electronic component within the Built-in Systems Interface (BSI) may not be to the correct specification. This could cause the audio-navigation system the wipers and exterior lighting to malfunction and the warning light on the instrument panel may illuminate.

richiami.difetto: Due to none conformity during manufacture the resistance of the insulated base inside the Engine Control Unit (ECU) which controls the electric motor may decrease. As a result the voltage in the circuit may become unstable causing the warning light to illuminate and the driving motor power to be restricted to the fail safe control. In the worst case scenario the vehicle may not be able to be restarted and the battery may not be able to be charged.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the engine ECU.
richiami.titolo: LOSS OF POWER

richiami.difetto: It is possible that a leak can occur between the injector spill rail connection and the plastic fuel return pipe. This can cause leakage of fuel which can either pool on the engine cylinder head and then become deposited onto the road surface where it could cause a skid risk to other motorist or if the fuel comes into contact with extremely hot engine components an exhaust manifold for instance it is possible that an under bonnet fire could ensue.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the sealing of the fuel return pipe connection on each injector and if necessary replace the injectors as well as the fuel return pipes.

richiami.titolo: WIPERS LIGHTS AND BATTERY CHARGING MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: The accelerator pedal plate may have been fitted with nuts that are not of the correct specification. In time the nuts may work loose making the pedal feel insecure.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the three accelerator pedal plate fixing nuts.
richiami.titolo: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY WORK LOOSE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that; with the engine switched off the side indicator repeaters do not operate when the parking lights are on.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant operating software upgraded.
richiami.titolo: INDICATOR SIDE REPEATERS MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is a risk of the engine stalling under very firm braking conditions.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is a risk of the engine stalling under very firm braking conditions.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the engine ECU software upgraded.

richiami.difetto: The brake pedal might feel stiff and the braking distances extended as a result of a defect in the vacuum pump.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the valve in the vacuum pump.
richiami.titolo: THE BRAKE PEDAL COULD BECOME STIFF THEREBY REDUCING BRAKING ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a problem may arise with the steering mechanism which can result in hardness whilst manoeuvring.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the steering mechanism checked and lubricated. The mechanism will be replaced if found to be damaged. At the same time certain vehicles will have key components reinforced against the ingress of water. Thus preventing operating faults in the long term.
richiami.titolo: STEERING MAY BECOME STIFF

richiami.difetto: Possible oil seepage in the brake assistance circuit that could damage the brake amplifier membrane and reduce braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the vacuum circuit valve and pipe which link the vacuum pump to the brake amplifier.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING ASSISTANCE MAY BE LOST

richiami.difetto: Braking maybe impaired due to some brake pipes not being manufactured to conformity.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the serial numbers of the brake pipes and to replace the brake pipes where necessary.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that vehicles fitted with 2I HDI engines may have been fitted a vacuum pump which may not be to specification. This could lead to a decrease in braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that vehicles fitted with 2I HDI engines may have been fitted a vacuum pump which may not be to specification. This could lead to a decrease in braking assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the vacuum pump replaced.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the operation of the  ABS/ESP braking unit may be affected by the ingress of water.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles to reinforce the resistance of the ABS/ESP unit to water.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that poor protection of the power steering pump earth terminal; could result in loss of power assistance to the steering.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the power steering pump earth terminal protection reinforced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that during the fuel tank production process the joint between the tank and the fuel supply pipe assembly may not have been produced to the correct standard. Should this indeed be the case leakage from the supply pipe area of the fuel tank might occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel tank inspected and replaced as necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a brake hose may become worn as a result of rubbing contact against the heat shield protecting the exhaust system. This may lead in extreme cases to a leak from a brake circuit which manifests itself in increased brake pedal travel.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the exhaust heat shield adjusted in order to maintain the correct distance from the subject brake hose. Should the hose display signs of wear it will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF EXTENDED BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on some vehicles fitted with electrically controlled seats in very rare cases and under certain impact conditions the front seatbelt may provide a diminished level of restraint.
richiami.rimedio: As a preventative measure subject vehicles will have the front seatbelt buckles replaced.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT MAY FAIL IN A COLLISION

richiami.difetto: If the battery voltage is abnormally low the antilock braking system electronic control unit may not perform to specification which in rare cases may cause a reduction in braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the Electronic Control Unit.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY REDUCE

richiami.difetto: If the battery voltage is abnormally low the antilock braking system electronic control unit may not perform to specification which in rare cases may cause a reduction in braking efficiency.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on certain vehicles a fault may be present on the diesel fuel circuit return pipe ay the location of the pressure sensor.In the manufacture of the pipe an excess of material resulted in a reduction of the pipe's internal diameter therefore restricting the fuel flow and a risk of a diesel leak from the fuel connector.
richiami.rimedio: Subject vehicles will have the diesel fuel delivery pressure in the injection pump checked. This will check the conformity of the pipe which in the case of nonconformity will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on a small number of vehicles the engine may have been fitted with a cylinder head where the lubrication circuit is not in conformity. This could result in failure of the engine.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the marking on the camshaft carrier checked and if found to be within the effected range the engine will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The seat belt locking action may not be as fast as it is designed to be.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that may be affecte check the date of manufacture of the seat belts and where necessary replace the seat belts.
richiami.titolo: SEATBELT MAY NOT OPERATE AS DESIGNED

richiami.difetto: The seat belt locking action may not be as fast as it is designed to be.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that may be affected and fit a separate air vent complete with filter to each electro valve fitted to the vacuum circuit.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the front air bag ECU may not take full account of frontal impacts that are below the legal threshold for triggering deployment.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the air bag ECU re-programmed.
richiami.titolo: FRONT AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS DESIGNED IN A FRONTAL IMPACT

richiami.difetto: Braking assistance could be adversely by freezing of moisture that may accumulate in the vacuum circuit.

richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the accelerator pedal replaced.

This would eventually lead to the illumination of the low fluid warning lamp which if left would result in longer brake pedal travel and reduced effectiveness of the brakes.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that likely to be affected and check for seepage of brake fluid. If the brake fluid seepage is apparent the flexible brake hose and the associated metal brake pipes will be replaced.

richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the engine management unit software upgraded.

richiami.difetto: On subject vehicles the indication of 2.5 bar pressure for the spare wheel  which can be found on a label affixed to the left hand door pillar  is incorrect for the vehicle specification.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have a replacement label affixed to the vehicle which will indicate the correct spare tyre pressure i.e. 4.2 bar. It should be noted that at manufacturethe tyre was inflated to the correct pressure however as a precaution the pressure of the spare wheel will be checked.
richiami.titolo: SPARE WHEEL TYRE PRESSURE INCORRECTLY STATED ON INFORMATION LABEL

richiami.difetto: A potential fault within the engine management system could cause an internal engine fuel leak via one or more of the injectors following engine switch off. The engine would then not restart because of the excess fuel present in the inlet manifold or cylinders.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the engine management unit software updated.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK INTO ENGINE

richiami.difetto: Due to draining of the condensation from the air conditioning system into the passenger compartment the air bag warning light may activate unintentionally. This in extreme cases may cause the air bag system to malfunction.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the sealing of the pipe which drains the condensation from the air conditioning system improved.

richiami.difetto: The diesel fuel return pipe of the injection system for 1.6 HDI ( DV6) engines carries the risk that over time seeping of fuel may occur due to nonconformity in manufacture.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the return pipe replaced with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: The diesel fuel return pipe of the injection system for 1.6 HDI ( DV6) engines carries the risk that over time seeping of fuel may occur due to nonconformity in manufacture.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the return pipe replaced with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: DIESEL FUEL RETURN PIPE MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: The diesel fuel return pipe of the injection system for 1.6 HDI ( DV6) engines carries the risk that over time seeping of fuel may occur due to nonconformity in manufacture.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the return pipe replaced with a quality assured item.

richiami.difetto: The C3 vehicles concerned are fitted with a panoramic sunroof in respect of which the mobile glass has securing nuts that do not meet the manufacturer's quality requirements.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the sunroof securing nuts.
richiami.titolo: THE SECURING NUTS OF THE  SUNROOF MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The dashboard harness on some vehicles may chafe which could cause random malfunctioning of the electric windows and in extreme cases could lead to a short circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely be affected and fit a plastic clip to the window switch wiring harness.
richiami.titolo: ABNORMAL WEAR ON THE DASHBOARD HARNESS

richiami.difetto: The brake hoses may chafe on the wheel aches and in extreme cases cause a brake fluid  leak. The driver will be informed of the defect by the illumination of a warning lamp on the dashboard. If ignored then this will result in longer than expected stopping distances.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and visually inspect the front brake hoses reinforcement and protection. The brake hoses if worn will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: THE BRAKE HOSE MAY CHAFE AND LEAK

richiami.difetto: The original ECU software could generate an excessive vibration of the injection butterfly. In very rare cases the butterfly upper stop may fail causing the engine to go to back up mode which may result in a drop of brake assistance efficiency
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and download new engine ECU software and initialisation of the ECU.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY REVERT TO BACK UP MODE.BRAKE ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE

richiami.difetto: Contact at full suspension travel may occur between the left hand rear splash shield and the brake hose. This may result in wearing of the hose after a period of time.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will have the splash shield modified and the brake hose re-routed.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CONTACT BETWEEN THE LEFT HAND REAR SPLASH SHIELD AND THE BRAKE HOSE.

richiami.difetto: The accelerator pedal can become jammed in the fully open position.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the accelerator pedal stop with a modified version.
richiami.titolo: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY STICK OPEN.

richiami.difetto: Possibility that roof bars may slip when bulky objects are placed on them
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace roof bars with modified type.
richiami.titolo: ROOF BARS MAY SLIP

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of defective components in the heater blower which could cause a short circuit and a loss of ventilation of the passenger compartment and in an extreme condition could set fire to the wiring harness.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace heater blower module.
richiami.titolo: HEATER BLOWER MODULE - RISK OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: The handbrake adjustment system may be unreliable which will reduce its efficiency under certain conditions.
richiami.rimedio: Check adjust and/or replace the brake shoe mechanisms.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE EFFICIENCY

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of disengagement of the accelerator pedal from the support linkage which could result in loss of acceleration
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace accelerator pedal clips
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF ACCELERATION

richiami.difetto: Under severe operating conditions and high mileage the pressed aluminium road wheels may crack around the wheel fixing holes. This could ultimately result in the detachment of a wheel.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the wheels with a modified type.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF ROAD WHEEL

richiami.difetto: The wiring connections to the left and right side lateral airbags may have been transposed. This could result in deployment of the incorrect airbag in a collision.
richiami.rimedio: Check the wiring connections and correct them where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: TRANSPOSED WIRING CONNECTIONS AT AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT.

richiami.difetto: An  inadequate weld on the bottom engine mounting tie bar may fail and cause a serious engine vibration and separation of one of the driveshafts.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a replacement bottom engine mounting tie bar.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF THE BOTTOM ENGINE MOUNTING TIE BAR

richiami.difetto: Inadequate protection of the heater blower wiring harness may result in chafing damage leading to a short circuit and risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Check for correct routing of the blower wiring harness and fit a protective sleeve.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK IN HEATER BLOWER WIRING HARNESS

richiami.difetto: Water ingress into the airbag electronic control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
richiami.rimedio: Seal the airbag ECU compartment.
richiami.titolo: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU

richiami.difetto: When the vehicle is moving an electrical signal could neutralise the sliding door safety lock and allow the door to open unintentionally.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a replacement electronic control unit to the door.
richiami.titolo: ELECTRICAL SIGNAL COULD NEUTRALISE THE SLIDING DOOR SAFETY LOCK.

richiami.difetto: Vacuum Servo Pipe may become detached resulting in loss of servo assistance
richiami.rimedio: Replace vacuum pipe
richiami.titolo: BRAKE SERVO VACUUM PIPE MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: Transposed wiring connections to the side air bags control unit will result in deployment of the air bag on the opposite side of an impact.
richiami.rimedio: Correct the wiring connections.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT WIRING CONNECTIONS TO AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT

richiami.difetto: Vehicles with the HDI engines but without the optional diesel fired heater may be fitted with the maxi-fuse supplying the fuel heater circuit. This can in certain cases lead to a short circuit and a consequential fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Remove the maxi-fuse.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT

richiami.difetto: Water ingress to the ABS ECU connector may cause a malfunction of the anti lock braking system. In the worst case water contamination could cause a short circuit and fire in the ABS control unit.
richiami.rimedio: Protect the ABS connector from water ingress. Replace the ABS ECU if found necessary.
richiami.titolo: WATER INGRESS MAY CAUSE ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT TO MALFUNCTION

richiami.difetto: The front passenger air bag may not fully deploy in an impact.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a replacement air bag.
richiami.titolo: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT COMPLETELY DEPLOY

richiami.difetto: The rear suspension cross member may have been cut in production. This could eventually result in failure of the cross member and cause loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Replace any rear suspension  cross member found to be cut.
richiami.titolo: REAR SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBER MAY HAVE BEEN CUT

richiami.difetto: The front suspension lower ball joint pinch bolts may not have been fully tightened.  In the worst case separation of the ball joint from the suspension arm would affect directional control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Check the ball joint pinch bolts for correct torque and tighten where necessary.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION BALL JOINT CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The anti lock brake control unit may overheat and cause the footbrake to revert to none anti lock mode.
richiami.rimedio: Check the ABS control unit identification number and replace the control unit where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: ABS CONTROL UNIT MAY OVERHEAT

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the handbrake will not hold the vehicle stationary if it is not fully applied.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a modified handbrake lever designed to ensure that an effective brake application is always made
richiami.titolo: REPLACEMENT OF HANDBRAKE LEVER

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the parking brake cable may not be to the correct specification and could break at the rear section resulting in loss of parking brake.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace parking brake cable.
richiami.titolo: PARKING BRAKE CABLE MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: A locking clip may not have been fitted correctly to one or more of the five clevis pins connecting the footbrake relay linkage inside the cabin. Disconnection of the linkage will result in the loss of service braking.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check that all five locking clips are secure.
richiami.titolo: SERVICE BRAKE LINKAGE MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED.

richiami.difetto: Water ingress into the underbonnet vacuum electrovalves may cause a reduction in power assistance at the brake pedal. Malfunction of the electrovalves could also adversely affect the engine exhaust emissions.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the three electrovalves as a precaution and install a protective shield over them.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE VACUUM ELECTROVALVES CONCERN.

richiami.difetto: Water ingress into the underbonnet vacuum electrovalves may cause a reduction in power assistance at the brake pedal. Malfunction of the electrovalves could also adversely affect the engine exhaust emissions.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the three electrovalves as a precaution and install a protective shield over them.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE VACUUM ELECTROVALVES CONCERN.

richiami.difetto: A defect in the ABS (Antilock Brake) ring on the front wheel bearings may cause a malfunction of the Antilock Brake System.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit new front wheel bearings.
richiami.titolo: ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The camshaft drive belt may fail before the recommended replacement interval of 72000 miles. This could result in a complete loss of engine power without warning.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured replacement camshaft drive belt.
richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF CAMSHAFT DRIVE BELT

richiami.difetto: A potential defect in the rear brake caliper may cause the parking brake efficiency to be reduced.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check the operation of each brake caliper and replacement of the caliper if necessary.
richiami.titolo: PARKING BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED

richiami.difetto: Fuel tank rear mountings may not adequately secure the tank with a risk of possible disengagement.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit additional bolts or reinforcement plates to rear tank mountings depending on original build configuration.
richiami.titolo: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS

richiami.difetto: Possibility of failure of the vacuum pump drive dog leading to a loss of brake assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the potentially affected range of vehicles and replace the drive dog on those equipped with a Magneti Marelli Vacuum pump
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL LOSS OF BRAKE VACUUM ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that due to incorrect machining of the suspension ball joint clamp bolt hole on the pivot the ball joint may disengage.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check and replace pivot if necessary.

richiami.difetto: Due to a possible fault within the control switch the passenger air bag may not be deactivated when the switch is in the off position.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled and the function of the deactivation control switch checked. Should a defective switch be found it will be replaced with a quality assured unit.
richiami.titolo: THE PASSENGER AIR BAG MIGHT REMAIN ACTIVE WHEN THE DEACTIVATE MODE HAS BEEN SELECTED

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the brake servo valve may not function correctly resulting in loss of servo assistance to the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for the inspection and possible replacement of the brake servo valve.

richiami.difetto: Potential interference between handbrake cables and rear brake pipes could lead to wear of brake pipes and in extreme circumstances loss of brake fluid which could reduce the effectiveness of the footbrake.
richiami.rimedio: Recall potentially affected vehicles for a check that adequate clearance exists and realignment of the pipes if needed.

richiami.difetto: Premature wear of the handbrake ratchet pawl may lead to inadvertent release of the handbrake. Problem of material hardness discovered in Quality Control tests.
richiami.rimedio: All vehicles from the period of production that may have a defective lever to be recalled and a new lever fitted.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE PREMATURE WEAR OF HANDBRAKE RATCHET PAWL

richiami.difetto: There is a risk of disengagement of the drivers seat catch allowing the seat to move on its runners.
richiami.rimedio: The recall operation will check the security of the seat runner which will be replaced if necessary. In some cases replacement of the seat frame will be required.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DISENGAGEMENT OF DRIVING SEAT CATCH

richiami.difetto: 1) The seat belt may jam following normal operation of the seat belt pretensioners in an accident. 2) The drivers airbag may deploy involuntarily.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and:- 1) Replace the original seat belt buckle and its associated pretensioner control by new Autoliv components. 2) Upgrade the drivers airbag to the latest specification.
richiami.titolo: 1)SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY JAM FOLLOWING NORMAL OPERATION OF PRETENSIONER 2)INVOLUNTARY OPERATION OF DRIVERS AIR BAG

richiami.difetto: Under conditions of heavy braking the footbrake relay cross shaft ball joint may detach from its left hand mounting. This would result in failure of the service brake.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check that the ball joint is properly located in its bush. Where this is not the case the mounting assemblies will be adjusted or replaced as necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF SERVICE BRAKE FAILURE

richiami.difetto: Under conditions of heavy braking the footbrake relay cross shaft ball joint may detach from its left hand mounting. This would result in failure of the service brake.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check that the ball joint is properly located in its bush. Where this is not the case the mounting assemblies will be adjusted or replaced as necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF SERVICE BRAKE FAILURE

richiami.difetto: There may be inadequate clearance between one or both brake pipes at the master cylinder and a coolant pipe bracket on the cylinder head. Intermittent contact can consequently occur due to engine movement under high load. Should any of the brake
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and inspect and re-route the subject brake pipes. Any brake pipes found to be damaged will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES

richiami.difetto: Instances have occurred of Xantia vehicles moving away following an incomplete application of the parking brake by the driver.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles to fit a modified parking brake lever which will prevent the driver from making only a partial application of the parking brake.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF VEHICLE ROLLING AWAY WHILST PARKED

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the front brake pipe may be contacted by the anti-roll bar link rod. In extreme conditions this may result in fluid leakage and partial loss of braking.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles will be recalled and inspected for contact between the brake pipes and the anti-roll bar link. If no contact has taken place the pipe(s) will be re-set to ensure adequate clearance . Any pipes showing signs of contact will be replaced
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE PIPE CHAFE CONDITION

richiami.difetto: Due to the possibility of incomplete application of the parking brake by the driver the vehicle could roll away when parked.
richiami.rimedio: The manufacturer will write to all Xantia owners enclosing an amendment for insertion in the vehicle handbook. This will amplify and reinforce the instructions relating to the operation of the parking brake.
richiami.titolo: APPLICATION OF PARKING BRAKE

richiami.difetto: Due to the effects of age and temperature the underbonnet rubber fuel lines may harden. This could lead to the possibility of fuel leakage particularly when the engine is cold.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the existing fuel pipes with the modified versions introduced to production vehicles in 1992.
richiami.titolo: HARDENING OF FUEL LINES

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the clutch lever may foul a moulded clip which secures the engine wiring harness. Should this occur the clip may open releasing the harness and making it liable to chafing and damage by the clutch lever.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and substitute a nylon fixing strap for the original moulded harness clip. This will ensure adequate operating clearance for the clutch lever.
richiami.titolo: CLUTCH LEVER MAY FOUL ENGINE WIRING
